Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000686553 Once the AdSense account is created, there are two types of ads that can be implemented on the website. How AdSense works Very Important Note: 1. For any banners to display on the website it is required to have "Display Banner Advertisements" set to "Yes" on the " Banner Ad Design " tab. 2. Make sure to add the Ads.txt on the "Enter Ads.txt Content" Field, if the banners don't display it is because the site is missing this Google Verification. 1.
